workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Company tools refuse a slug with an apostrophe, such as lowe's-home-improvement
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(company): Accept an apostrophe in a company slug. Target files: linkedin_mcp_server/linkedin/identifiers.py, tests/test_identifiers.py, changelog.d/1506.fix.md. - `_COMPANY_SLUG` refused `lowe's-home-improvement` in every form, though `classify_link` emits it as a `/company/` reference. - The slug now takes `'` as well, next to `&` and `.`. Person identifiers are unchanged. - `company_page_url` leaves the `'` as is rather than writing `%27`, the same as `&`. - . (Ref: https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1506)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Job tools refuse a slugged job link with punctuation in the title
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(jobs): Accept punctuation in a job URL slug. Target files: linkedin_mcp_server/linkedin/identifiers.py, tests/test_identifiers.py, changelog.d/1493.fix.md. - `_numeric_tail` allowed only word characters and hyphens before the id, so a slugged link like `/jobs/view/senior-.net-developer-at-acme-<id>/` was refused. `classify_link` and the browser's job-id extraction already read the id from it. - It now allows any character in the slug, as `JOB_PATH_RE` does. A bare argument is still strictly numeric, and... (Ref: https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1493)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Job tools refuse the job link a browser shows during a job search
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(jobs): Accept a job id from a job search link. workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Four tools start the browser before refusing invalid input
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tools): Refuse bad input before the browser. Target files: linkedin_mcp_server/linkedin/identifiers.py, linkedin_mcp_server/linkedin/message_sender.py, linkedin_mcp_server/tools/job.py. - `get_easy_apply_form`, `dismiss_job`, `reply_to_conversation` and `search_posts` called `get_ready_extractor` before checking their input. A bad job id, thread id or post filter could start a browser, install Chromium or spend a login before the caller saw the refusal. The other tools refuse first. - Each now checks it... (Ref: https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1429)
